title: Jake's Nap
synopsis: Jake tries to take one uninterrupted nap and the entire Land of Ooo conspires against him.
plot:
Jake announces that he has been awake for three days straight helping Finn with a dungeon and is going to take a nap. A real nap. The good kind. He builds a nest of blankets on the Tree Fort couch and is asleep in seconds. Forty seconds later Finn drops a suit of armor down the ladder.

What follows is an escalating series of interruptions: BMO decides today is the day to learn the drums, Shelby needs help moving a very small piano, and Tree Trunks arrives with an apple pie emergency that turns out to be that she baked too many pies and needs someone to eat them. Each time, Jake stretches himself to a new sleeping spot, and each time the world finds him.

Eventually Jake stretches himself into a flat sheet and lies across the entire Grass Lands so that there is nowhere he is not. Finn, BMO, Shelby, and Tree Trunks all end up sitting on him. It is quiet. Jake finally sleeps. When he wakes up, everyone else is asleep too, and Mr. Pig has tucked a blanket over all of them.
transcriptText:
Jake: Three days. Three days of dungeon. I am going to nap so hard.
Finn: You've earned it, buddy.
Jake: [already asleep] Zzz.
[CRASH. A suit of armor tumbles down the ladder.]
Finn: Sorry! Sorry. That was the armor. It's fine. Go back to sleep.
Jake: ...
[BMO enters carrying a drum kit twice its size.]
BMO: Today BMO becomes a drummer!
Jake: BMO. Please.
BMO: The drums do not wait for anybody, Jake.
[Jake stretches out the window and curls up on the roof.]
Shelby: Hey Jake. Hey. Jake. I need help moving my piano.
Jake: You have a piano?
Shelby: It's very small. That's why I need help. I can't find it.
[Jake stretches across the Grass Lands to Tree Trunks' porch.]
Tree Trunks: Oh, Jake! Thank goodness. It's an emergency.
Jake: [muffled] What kind of emergency.
Tree Trunks: I made forty pies.
Jake: That's not an emergency, that's a Tuesday.
Tree Trunks: They're all cooling on the one table and the table is starting to bend.
Jake: [sitting up] Okay. New plan.
[Jake flattens himself into a vast sheet that covers the whole meadow.]
Finn: Jake? Where'd you go?
Jake: [from everywhere] I'm the floor now. Everybody sit down.
BMO: The floor is warm.
Shelby: Found my piano. It was in my pocket.
Tree Trunks: I'll just set these pies right here.
Jake: Zzzzz.
Mr. Pig: [whispering] Shh. Let them rest.
